correctness.rationale: Solve killed two-component backward ODE for Laplace transforms H of total capture and G of signed approach side, using active Dirichlet values plus inactive continuity and derivative matching at the transparent origin. For a given reset rate r, derive retained-gate renewal matrix rL with L_ij=(rI-Q)^(-1)_ij-H_i[(rI-Q)^(-1)]_Aj and solve p=fplus+rLp. This reproduces the stated PA, PI and PE formulas, including the r->0 continuation. For strict monotonicity, F and alpha/(r+lambda) decrease, while (1-F)/(r+lambda) is strictly decreasing; factor 1/(1+rho) also decreases. Independent numerical resolvent calculations at five parameter points matched both initial-gate closed formulas, and strong/weak reset expansions follow analytically. Brownian crossing direction is a marked absorption event, not a reflecting-gate boundary.

final_claim: For Brownian motion on R reset to x0>0 at rate r>=0 with independent two-state gate active->inactive alpha>0 inactive->active beta>0 retained across resets and transparent inactive origin, the initial-active and initial-inactive probabilities of finally hitting the active origin from positive side are PA=1-alpha(1-F)/(2(r+lambda)(1+rho)), PI=1-[F+alpha(1-F)/(r+lambda)]/[2(1+rho)], where lambda=alpha+beta, rho=sqrt(r/(r+lambda)), F=exp(-x0 sqrt((r+lambda)/D)); stationary-gate PE is their beta/alpha mixture. All increase strictly with r, wrong-side capture ~alpha/(4r), and PE has a universal positive sqrt(r) weak-reset correction.
